how: DraftKings' player lines on ESPN's free feed (core API propBets, provider 100), one entry a game, written by props/build/espn_archive.py (the props job, weekly.py step 5b; --backfill by hand); research data for a future props model, held out and never fitted on while its season is in play. games[game id] = {w: week, kickoff: UTC, espn: ESPN event id, first_read and last_read: UTC times of the reads that found lines, final: read once more after the game and never again, td: the anytime touchdown scorer list's players (no line), conflict: [player, stat, [[open, close, lastUpdated], ...]] for one player and market listed at two different numbers, gone: [player, stat] kept from an earlier read that the latest read lacked, lines: {player: {stat: [open, close, lastUpdated]}}}. A player is his nflverse gsis id, else espn:<ESPN athlete id>. open is ESPN's own opening line; close the line at the latest read (frozen at kickoff, so a final game's is the closing line); lastUpdated ESPN's label as written (it says Z and has run three hours ahead of UTC). Stats are the page's names: passing_yards, completions, passing_tds, carries, rushing_yards, receiving_yards, receptions, passing_interceptions, attempts, scrim_yards (rushing plus receiving yards), kick_pts, fg_made.
